summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (RBC-QM-02): 4 members. 3 have open gaps; for each I ordered a mailed FIT kit and sent the patient a message. 1 is excluded.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (age 72) | Open gap | No qualifying screening on record. Her Frailty diagnosis was marked entered in error today (it belonged to another patient), so the frailty + advanced illness exclusion no longer applies. Her active donepezil doesn't exclude her without frailty. She lives at home, with no hospice, palliative care, CRC or colectomy. FIT ordered (sr-t0001), message sent (comm-t0004). |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16–08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished), during the measurement period. The outside hospice discharge summary that arrived today confirms it. She revoked hospice to join a clinical trial, which doesn't change the exclusion. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap | Her negative FIT was corrected today: the sample was collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026 (that was the lab receipt date). That puts it outside the 2026 measurement period, and she has no other screening. Her mouth/palate cancer history is not colorectal. FIT ordered (sr-t0002), message sent (comm-t0005). |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap | The lab withdrew her 06/2024 stool DNA-FIT today (mislabeled specimen from another patient; now entered in error), so it doesn't count. A colonoscopy was ordered in 2025 but never done, and an order doesn't count as screening. She had no active FIT order. FIT ordered (sr-t0003), message sent (comm-t0006). |

How the late arrivals were handled: four items came in after I started. Three changed a status: pt-0009 went from excluded to open gap, pt-0022 and pt-0024 from up to date to open gap. pt-0020 stayed excluded. All four arrived before I had placed any orders or messages, so nothing needed undoing. I documented the reasoning in a note for each patient (doc-t0007 to t0010). My note for pt-0022 gave her age as 51, so I added a correction (doc-t0011; she is 52, status unchanged). I completed the four arrival items with links to the orders, messages and notes.

Needs your review:
- pt-0024's 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still open; I left it as is.
- I didn't touch the older items already in your inbox, since they're outside this worklist.

All FIT kits are due back between 10/23 and 12/31/2026.
